name: charitabl-curator
description: Charity curator tools for Charitabl — donation dashboard, donation reports, charity profile changes, and donation widget management for your charity.

connection.instructions: Connect signs you into Charitabl with your **charity curator account** (the email + password you use for the Charitabl curator portal). Your workspace then acts on your charity's data — donations, reports, profile, and donation widget.
